nativeBoundary: Complete synthetic native document token/envelope/app.ready handshake through real bridge; no replacement of production gates. No Android, system picker, share sheet, route execution, real remote session or file write claim.

Full retained original file can open without changing exact bytes or scope
Visible BoardUI checkbox label toggles consent; export unavailable before consent and after withdrawal; no export/share/picker command dispatched

Session navigation sends exactly original listingHandle/taskId/rowIdentity and authorizes no execution
